files.description: EHI Export Guide PDF — 19-page document containing export instructions with UI screenshots, export format descriptions (C-CDA, Excel, Notes, Attachments), and a detailed data dictionary covering 15 entities with field-level definitions and value sets. This is the primary and sole export documentation artifact.
HTML source of the registered EHI export documentation landing page. Contains a download link to the PDF and a broken WordPress embeddoc shortcode that failed to render an embedded PDF viewer.
Screenshot of the landing page showing the download link and broken embeddoc shortcode. Taken via Chrome browser.
Bun TypeScript enrichment script that parses the PDF data dictionary into structured JSON. Uses pdftotext to extract text, then parses entities, fields, and value sets.
Structured JSON extraction of the PDF data dictionary. Contains 15 entities with 224 fields, 30 value sets with 256 entries, and export format descriptions. Machine-queryable.
List of Excel tab names documented in the export guide.
Enrichment documentation: run commands, input boundaries, output files, known parsing limitations.
